title: 9 Best Herbal Tinctures For Body Odor
description: Salvia officinalis tinctures, derived from the leaves of the sage plant, have been traditionally used to treat body odor due to their antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The tinctures contain bioactive constituents such as thujone, camphor, and borneol, which help to inhibit the growth of odor-causing bacteria on the skin.
